messages:
maria.product: Heads-up — I opened a draft for the Enterprise Audit Pipeline contract that we'd hand to customers as part of SOC2 evidence readiness. High level: packaged evidence export API, retention tiering (30/365/7k), legal-hold override, and SLA for export times. Need alignment on tech feasibility + legal wording.

aj.eng: skimmed it. overall looks fine. two immediate asks: 1) can we guarantee export within SLA for large tenants (100M events)? 2) need a clear contract for cold-archive retrieval costs.

simon.security: from security POV we need BYOK/HSMs for key wrapping of exported evidence, plus signed manifests. also want an immutable hash per export (sha256) and a chain-of-custody header.

lin.sre: on the throughput question: current ingest -> retention pipeline supports parallel export, but 100M events will need chunked streaming + resumable uploads. suggest we offer two export modes: fast (paid, parallel) and standard (queued). also include estimated egress cost metric in the contract.

dina.legal: drafting contract language around "evidence portability" and "retention exceptions" — legal hold must supersede retention. we need a short runbook for customers to trigger legal hold and proof that data won't be deleted while hold is active.

ops-bot: CI:export-pipeline-tests #432 passed on main — includes large-file chunked download test. link: https://ci.redwood.ai/build/432

maria.product: good notes. proposal: 1) add two SLA tiers for exports (48h standard, 6h premium up to X size) 2) mandatory signed manifest + sha256 3) legal-hold API with retention-override flag 4) cost-estimate calc exposed in Console. any immediate blockers?

aj.eng: tech blocker: HSM-backed key wrapping requires private deployment customers or dedicated node with HSM in Dedicated offering. Hosted can support envelope encryption with KMS but not raw HSM for customer keys unless we add escrow flow.

simon.security: agree. we should scope a phased rollout: Phase A = hosted with KMS-wrapped exports + signed manifest; Phase B = Dedicated/Private with customer HSM + on-prem escrow support. include clear migration steps.

lin.sre: ops checklist request: export-runbooks, retry policies, backpressure behaviour, and a dashboard showing backlog per-tenant. I'll draft SLOs for export latency and success rate.

dina.legal: for SOC2 evidence packaging we need timestamped manifests and certifying statement template. also need clause for retention-change notifications (30 days notice) and opt-in for immediate deletions by customer request.

maria.product: action items — add owners/ETA: 1) aj -> export API spec draft with chunking + resumability (due: 2026-04-09) 2) simon -> security spec for manifest + hash + keyflow (due: 2026-04-06) 3) lin -> ops runbook + SLOs (due: 2026-04-10) 4) dina -> contract language + SOC2 evidence clause (due: 2026-04-07) 5) product -> console cost preview UX (due: 2026-04-13). please confirm. :thumbsup:

aj.eng: confirmed. I'll include a sample curl + streaming example in the spec: 
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \\
  -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/exports \\
  -d '{"tenant_id":"acme-123","range":{"from":"2025-01-01","to":"2025-12-31"},"format":"parquet","mode":"resumable"}'
```

simon.security: noted. sample manifest structure we'll require: 
```json
{
  "export_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "acme-123",
  "created_at": "2026-03-20T18:12:00Z",
  "parts": [{"part":"0001","sha256":"...","size": 104857600}],
  "signature": "base64(sig)",
  "certifying_statement": "Exported by Redwood Inference, signed"
}
```

lin.sre: small ops question — do we keep ephemeral exports around? propose: 14 days default ephemeral cache for downloads, then purge (unless customer requests archived delivery). mark in contract.

dina.legal: 14 days cache OK, but legal hold should pin until released. we need audit trail for hold creation + owner. also include a stop-gap eDiscovery manual assist channel for large subpoenas.

maria.product: consensus for phased rollout + SLAs. I'll update the draft and schedule a short workshop with Sales & Support to align on pricing for premium export lane. meeting: 2026-03-25 10:00 PT.

aj.eng: one more technical flag — we need to expose `retention_override=true` only with signed legal auth token (JWT) in API. will include in spec.

simon.security: approve that pattern. also require export manifests to be timestamped with NTP-synced server and include server cert fingerprint.

maria.product: thanks team — I'll push updated draft by EOD. if anyone wants to add edge cases, drop them here.

lin.sre: adding edge case: cross-region exports (EU tenant -> US storage) — need consent checkbox and data transfer note.

dina.legal: good catch, require explicit customer consent in contract + UI when opting cross-region.

ops-bot: Reminder scheduled: workshop created — https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/54321

maria.product: :raised_hands: great. wrapping up — will track progress in the Product roadmap card (epic: audit-pipeline-exports) and ping again after AJ's spec is up.
